def to_chinese_numeral(n):
    def convert_digit(digit, multiplier):
        if digit == 0:
            return ""
        elif digit == 1:
            return "一" + (multiplier if multiplier != "十" else "")
        else:
            return "一" + multiplier + convert_digit(digit - 1, multiplier)

    def convert_integer_part(n):
        if n < 0:
            return "负" + convert_integer_part(-n)
        if n == 0:
            return "零"
        if n < 10:
            return "一" + convert_digit(n, "")
        if n < 100:
            tens = n // 10
            ones = n % 10
            return convert_digit(tens, "十") + convert_digit(ones, "")
        if n < 1000:
            hundreds = n // 100
            rest = n % 100
            return convert_digit(hundreds, "百") + convert_integer_part(rest)
        if n < 10000:
            thousands = n // 1000
            rest = n % 1000
            return convert_integer_part(thousands) + "千" + convert_integer_part(rest)
        if n < 100000:
            ten_thousands = n // 10000
            rest = n % 10000
            return convert_integer_part(ten_thousands) + "万" + convert_integer_part(rest)
        raise ValueError("Input out of range")

    def convert_decimal_part(n):
        if n == 0:
            return ""
        decimal_str = str(n)
        decimal_part = decimal_str.split('.')[1]
        chinese_decimal = ''
        for i, digit in enumerate(decimal_part):
            chinese_decimal += to_chinese_numeral(int(digit)) + '点' if i == 0 else to_chinese_numeral(int(digit))
        return chinese_decimal

    integer_part = convert_integer_part(int(n))
    decimal_part = convert_decimal_part(n - int(n))
    return integer_part + decimal_part
